nodes.description: ERC20Basic.totalSupply, total token supply, mutated by mint().
balanceOf(address) constant, returns balances[_owner].
BasicToken.transfer(address,uint256), moves tokens from msg.sender using SafeMath sub/add.
mapping(address=>uint256) balances, per-account token balances.
StandardToken.transferFrom(address,address,uint256), spends allowance and moves balances.
mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint256)) allowed, ERC20 allowances.
approve(address,uint256), sets allowance with zero-first race mitigation.
allowance(address,address) constant, returns allowed[_owner][_spender].
Ownable.owner, privileged address used by onlyOwner guard and selfdestruct target.
transferOwnership(address) onlyOwner, reassigns owner.
Pausable.paused flag gating buyTicketsFor via whenNotPaused.
pause() onlyOwner whenNotPaused, sets paused=true.
unpause() onlyOwner whenPaused, sets paused=false.
SlotTicket.mint(address,uint256) onlyOwner, increases totalSupply and balances.
SlotTicket.destroy() onlyOwner, selfdestructs the token contract to owner.
Slot.token, SlotTicket instance created in constructor and minted to buyers.
mapping(uint=>mapping(uint=>address)) participants, game=>index=>player address.
uint256[] prizes, ether amounts paid to the winners of each draw.
Slot.jackpot accumulator, paid out by distributeJackpot and reset to 0.
Slot.gameNumber, current lottery round, incremented at end of awardPrizes.
Slot.wallet, house wallet receiving 2.49 finney per draw.
Slot.counter, global ticket counter driving game/seat indexing.
Slot(address) payable constructor, deploys token, sets wallet, jackpot, gameNumber, counter.
payable fallback, forwards to buyTicketsFor(msg.sender).
buyTicketsFor(address) payable whenNotPaused, computes tickets, mints tokens, registers participants, refunds change.
addParticipant(address,uint256) private, loops writing participants and triggers awardPrizes every SIZE tickets.
rand(uint32) private constant, pseudo-random value from blockhash(block.number-1) and block.number-10.
awardPrizes() private, draws winner, pays prizes, updates jackpot, wallet, gas refund and gameNumber.
distributeJackpot(uint256) private, transfers jackpot to winner and zeroes it.
refundAll() onlyOwner, refunds PRICE to pending participants and decrements counter.
Slot.destroy() onlyOwner, destroys token and selfdestructs to owner.
changeWallet(address) onlyOwner, replaces house wallet address.
msg.sender, attacker-controlled caller used for balances, allowances, owner check, refunds and beneficiary.
selfdestruct(owner) inside SlotTicket.destroy, irreversible contract termination.
selfdestruct(owner) inside Slot.destroy after token.destroy(), irreversible termination and ETH sweep.
msg.sender.transfer(change) inside buyTicketsFor, external ETH send to untrusted caller.
participants[gameNumber][winnerIndex%SIZE].transfer(prizes[i]) in awardPrizes, ETH sent to arbitrary winner address.
wallet.transfer(2.49 finney) in awardPrizes, external ETH send to house wallet.
msg.sender.transfer(0.01 finney) gas reimbursement in awardPrizes.
participants[gameNumber][_winnerIndex].transfer(jackpot) in distributeJackpot before resetting jackpot.
participants[gameNumber][i].transfer(PRICE) in refundAll loop, ETH sent to arbitrary participants.
token.mint(beneficiary, numberOfTickets) external call from buyTicketsFor into SlotTicket.
token.destroy() external call from Slot.destroy terminating the token contract.
unchecked counter arithmetic (++counter, counter -= counter%SIZE) not routed through SafeMath.
keccak256(blockhash(block.number-1), blockhash(block.number-10)) weak block-attribute randomness used to pick winners.

edges.reason: _to parameter is used as the recipient key in balances[_to] inside transfer.
_value parameter determines the amount subtracted/added in transfer.
_owner indexes balances in balanceOf.
_from is the debited account and allowance owner in transferFrom.
_to is the credited account in transferFrom.
_value is the transferred amount and allowance decrement in transferFrom.
_spender is the allowance key in approve.
_value is the allowance amount set in approve.
newOwner becomes the new owner state value.
_to receives freshly minted balance in SlotTicket.mint.
_amount is added to totalSupply and balances in mint.
_wallet is stored into the wallet state variable by the constructor.
beneficiary receives tokens, participant slots and refund flows in buyTicketsFor.
_participant is written into participants mapping.
_numberOfTickets bounds the participation loop and counter growth.
_size is the modulus applied to the hash-derived random value.
_winnerIndex selects the jackpot recipient in participants mapping.
_newWallet is assigned to the wallet state variable.
Local change is computed from msg.value and returned to msg.sender.
Local numberOfTickets drives token.mint and addParticipant calls.
Loop index i drives participant writes and counter increments.
randomNumber is the return value produced from block hashes.
winnerIndex selects the participants storage slot paid in awardPrizes.
jackpotWon gates the distributeJackpot call.
Loop index i selects prizes[i] for each payout.
Loop index i selects the participant address refunded in refundAll.
msg.sender is the fallback-derived beneficiary and the change-refund recipient.
Fallback forwards msg.sender into buyTicketsFor.
transfer debits and credits balances[msg.sender].
transferFrom reads and writes allowed[_from][msg.sender].
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][_spender].
buyTicketsFor calls the external token.mint with buyer-derived values.
Slot.destroy calls the external token.destroy().
Constructor deploys a new SlotTicket and stores it in token.
Constructor assigns _wallet to the wallet state variable.
_wallet flows directly into the wallet state variable.
Fallback function unconditionally executes buyTicketsFor.
buyTicketsFor calls addParticipant after minting tokens.
addParticipant triggers awardPrizes whenever ++counter%SIZE == 0.
awardPrizes calls distributeJackpot when jackpotWon and i==0.
awardPrizes calls rand for winnerIndex and for the jackpot check.
rand composes blockhash values into a predictable pseudo-random number.
onlyOwner mint can arbitrarily inflate totalSupply and any balance.
onlyOwner destroy terminates the token contract via selfdestruct.
addParticipant increments counter without SafeMath, allowing unchecked wrap-around growth.
addParticipant mutates the counter state variable used for game/seat indexing.
awardPrizes increments gameNumber after all payouts.
awardPrizes adds 2.5 finney to the jackpot accumulator.
distributeJackpot zeroes the jackpot after transferring it.
refundAll decrements counter by counter%SIZE.
changeWallet reassigns the wallet state variable.
transferOwnership writes the owner state variable under onlyOwner.
mint credits the balances mapping of the target address.
transfer updates the balances mapping for sender and receiver.
transferFrom updates balances of _from and _to.
transferFrom decrements allowed[_from][msg.sender].
approve writes the allowed mapping.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
onlyOwner refundAll iterates and pays pending participant addresses.
msg.sender.transfer(change) sends ETH to an untrusted caller inside buyTicketsFor, enabling callback into token/buy flows.
awardPrizes transfers ETH to winner addresses that may be attacker contracts, re-entering the draw logic.
gameNumber is only incremented after all winner transfers, so a re-entrant call could act on the stale game.
distributeJackpot transfers jackpot before setting it to zero, leaving state inconsistent during the external call.
refundAll performs participant transfers before decrementing counter, allowing re-entrant refunds.

Amount parameter flows directly into balances updates in transfer; merge into the transfer function node.

Mint amount parameter used only inside SlotTicket.mint.

Winner index local selects payout slots inside awardPrizes.
Jackpot flag local gates distributeJackpot inside awardPrizes.
Prize loop index local exists only inside awardPrizes.
Winner index parameter selects the jackpot recipient in distributeJackpot.
Refund loop index local exists only inside refundAll.
New wallet parameter is assigned to wallet inside changeWallet.
